This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts/gas-tank).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Whether the prefab gas tanks also spawn at 60 atm was not established.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/14/limitations/0`

**Definition-only extraction**

> Capacity, compression, reference conditions for gas litres and maximum safe pressure are unknown. The medium variant's content description says fluid; the other three say gas.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/189/limitations/4`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.

comments.body: Partly answered in c5441a0 (tank capacities, pressure law, gas tank start pressure, hose exchange with no length term, damping names absent from the binary; see investigation/fluids-network.md). The remaining open items are listed on the wiki page.
